newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli criminal car bomb blast kills one - police.
newsitem.headline: Israeli criminal car bomb blast kills one - police.

text.p: A car bomb explosion killed a man on Tuesday in a Tel Aviv-area blast that police ascribed to criminals.
Two people were lightly wounded when the car owner opened a door, setting off the explosion that killed him and damaged a building in the suburb of Bnei Brak.
"When the owner opened the car, it blew up," said a Tel Aviv police spokeswoman. "The background is criminal." She declined to identify the dead man but said he was known to police.
